correctness.rationale: Independent with-replacement selections give exact all-subset survival identity. A product domination bounds factorial moments and absolutely controls Laplace series; Riemann and power-sum estimates yield fixed-fanin x^k dx and logarithmic-fanin e^y dy Poisson limits. Void-probability tail control gives oldest-vertex Weibull and reversed-Gumbel laws. Markov and negative-covariance Chebyshev give sharp outer macroscopic cases. Exact package checker passed 497 finite and numerical checks, explicitly not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A naturally defined oldest surviving childless vertex is important to how far back active outputs persist in a recursively generated circuit. The all-order factorial survival law yields an unstudied early-output Poisson point process for each fixed multi-parent count, and logarithmically growing fan-in gives a sharp macroscopic age transition with a new reversed-Gumbel extreme-value class. Neither a global output-count CLT nor the one-parent Rayleigh theorem supplies this dependence on fan-in.
